verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing docs describe this workflow directly. A preview with `draft: true` (text-, image- or video-to-video) bills at the cheaper 480p rate, and a chosen preview can be enhanced to 1080p by passing `draftTaskId` on text-to-video. The pricing page separately lists unlimited 4K video upscaling. Missing for 10: draft-to-final enhancement is only documented for text-to-video, not image- or video-to-video drafts; no stated speed advantage for draft mode; no independent or hands-on corroboration of the draft→enhance flow.
